name: Fancy Area
summary: Tutorial and code for a markdown textarea with @mention support and hover cards, like GitHub's PR comment box.
description: A write-up of a markdown textarea with @mention support: a combobox opens inside the textarea as you type @, mentions render as hover cards in the preview, and markdown is transformed to React with rehype. Built with shadcn/ui components (Tabs, Command/cmdk, Textarea, HoverCard, Avatar), Tailwind CSS and the typography plugin.
